remarks:
Welcome to the beautiful Patio D at Marrano Homes’ Mission Hills patio home community in Hamburg, NY! This inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bath home features a warm color palette and thoughtfully designed open-concept living. The spacious kitchen flows seamlessly into the living room, complete with a cozy fireplace and adjoining sunroom, creating the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining. The stunning kitchen showcases quartz countertops, a ceramic tile backsplash, ceiling-height cabinetry, and an oversized island offering plenty of room for gathering. Luxury vinyl plank flooring extends throughout the home, adding both style and durability. Enjoy the convenience of first-floor laundry and retreat to the spacious primary suite, which features a walk-in closet and a private bath with a ceramic tile shower. Step outside to the covered patio off the sunroom and enjoy the ease of low-maintenance patio home living! Pictures do not depict the actual home but are to show the layout.
See also ML#B1723257.
